color.note: Primitives first (ice neutrals, spectral holo, signal hues), then semantic roles that alias them. Components and product code use ONLY the semantic roles. Light is the one shipped theme.

tokens.name: ice-0
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pure white — reserved for surface-raised (menus, popovers, modals). Never the page.

tokens.name: ice-25
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pearl white — cards, inputs, panels.

tokens.name: ice-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Icy page ground.

tokens.name: ice-75
tokens.usage: Primitive. Sidebar, wells, disabled fills.

tokens.name: ice-100
tokens.usage: Primitive. Hover fill.

tokens.name: ice-150
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pressed fill, slider and progress tracks.

tokens.name: ice-200
tokens.usage: Primitive. Hairline dividers and card edges.

tokens.name: ice-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Default decorative border.

tokens.name: ice-400
tokens.usage: Primitive. Strong decorative border, skeleton shimmer peak.

tokens.name: ice-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Control borders (3:1 on every ground).

tokens.name: ice-550
tokens.usage: Primitive. Disabled text (exempt from contrast).

tokens.name: ice-600
tokens.usage: Primitive. Tertiary text.

tokens.name: ice-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Secondary text.

tokens.name: ice-900
tokens.usage: Primitive. Ink — primary text and primary action fill.

tokens.name: electric-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Brand soft tint.

tokens.name: electric-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Electric blue — the one saturated brand hue.

tokens.name: electric-600
tokens.usage: Primitive. Electric blue hover.

tokens.name: electric-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Electric blue pressed; brand text on tints.

tokens.name: violet-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Violet tint.

tokens.name: violet-600
tokens.usage: Primitive. Cool violet — secondary brand hue.

tokens.name: focus-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Focus ring hue, 5.4:1+ on every ground.

tokens.name: holo-ice
tokens.usage: Spectral stop 1 — icy cyan. Only inside iridescent gradients.

tokens.name: holo-blue
tokens.usage: Spectral stop 2 — electric blue, pastel.

tokens.name: holo-violet
tokens.usage: Spectral stop 3 — cool violet, pastel.

tokens.name: holo-magenta
tokens.usage: Spectral stop 4 — soft magenta, pastel.

tokens.name: holo-pearl
tokens.usage: Spectral accent — pearl green. A sliver at the end of a gradient, never a fill.

tokens.name: holo-cyan-deep
tokens.usage: Saturated spectral stop for progress fills (3.2:1 on the track).

tokens.name: holo-blue-deep
tokens.usage: Saturated spectral stop for progress fills and holo borders.

tokens.name: holo-violet-deep
tokens.usage: Saturated spectral stop for progress fills and holo borders.

tokens.name: holo-magenta-deep
tokens.usage: Saturated spectral stop for progress fills and holo borders.

tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: App page ground behind everything.

tokens.name: background-subtle
tokens.usage: Sidebar, section wells, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Neutral Surface material: cards, inputs, list panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Elevated Surface material: menus, popovers, toasts, modals, player bar.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, ghost buttons, nav items.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill; slider and progress tracks.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Tooltips and the primary button fill.

tokens.name: border-subtle
tokens.usage: Dividers, card edges, row separators. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default container border: menus, modals, secondary button edge.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, emphasized containers.

tokens.name: border-interactive
tokens.usage: Resting edge of inputs, checkboxes, radios, switch tracks. 3:1 on background and surface.

tokens.name: border-selected
tokens.usage: Selected card, selected chip, checked control edge.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles and body on background, surface, surface-raised, hover and pressed (14:1+).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Artist names, descriptions, inactive nav on every neutral ground (6:1+).

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Metadata, durations, placeholders, captions on every neutral ground (4.6:1+).

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only — exempt from contrast; always paired with a disabled cursor/state.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse, brand-primary, danger fills.

tokens.name: text-brand
tokens.usage: Links, active nav label, now-playing title on neutral and holo-soft grounds (5.2:1+).

tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: Checked controls, switch-on track, selected borders, links. White text on it reads 6:1.

tokens.name: brand-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary brand accent — featured labels, rare emphasis.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tonal button fill, selected row/chip fill.

tokens.name: brand-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on brand-primary fills.

tokens.name: brand-active
tokens.usage: Pressed brand fill; brand text on brand-soft (8:1).

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill — ink, not blue. Premium, neutral.

tokens.name: action-primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary button hover.

tokens.name: action-primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary button pressed.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text/icon on success-soft, surface, background (4.9:1+).

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success badge and toast tint.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text/icon on warning-soft, surface, background (5.4:1+).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning badge and toast tint.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive fill (white text 5.8:1), error text and icons.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Destructive button hover and pressed.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Danger badge, destructive ghost hover.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info text/icon on info-soft, surface, background (5.3:1+).

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info badge tint.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The one focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: selected
tokens.usage: Selected row/option fill.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: Generic hover fill (alias of surface-hover).

tokens.name: pressed
tokens.usage: Generic pressed fill (alias of surface-pressed).

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and drawers.

gradient.note: Iridescent material. Rare by rule: brand, the play action, playing/selected state, featured cards, progress. Never a page or panel background, never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: iridescent-primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the iridescent Button and the Play button. Ink text/icons on it (10:1+).

tokens.name: iridescent-soft
tokens.usage: Featured card ground, splash. Barely-there pearl.

tokens.name: iridescent-border
tokens.usage: 1.5px ring on the Play button, playing cards and the brand symbol.

tokens.name: iridescent-foil
tokens.usage: Collectible frame of FeaturedCard only.

tokens.name: iridescent-highlight
tokens.usage: Foil glint swept slowly across a featured image on hover (duration-holo).

tokens.name: iridescent-progress
tokens.usage: Active track of the player ProgressBar; underline of the active TopNavItem.

tokens.name: iridescent-selected
tokens.usage: Now-playing TrackRow and QueueItem ground. Paired with the PlaybackState bars.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and splash titles only; one per screen.

styles.name: h1
styles.usage: Album, artist and playlist page titles.

styles.name: h2
styles.usage: Section headers on home and library.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: A slow-motion record about winter light.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Artist lines, card subtitles, menu hints.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, nav items, chips, tabs.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: UPPERCASE category labels on collectible cards and section kickers.

styles.name: metadata
styles.usage: Durations, time labels, bitrate, catalog numbers. Tabular figures.

spacing.note: 4px base. Primitives space-1…space-20; semantic insets give dense lists, medium cards and spacious heroes different rhythms.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Optical nudges, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text in badges, collectible frame padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, TrackRow vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding, card inner padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Default gap between related blocks; mobile gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card grid gap on tablet.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Panel padding; card grid gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop gutter; gap between shelf title and shelf.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Gap between page header and content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on home.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Hero vertical padding (tablet).

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Hero vertical padding (desktop), splash.

tokens.name: inset-row
tokens.usage: DENSE — TrackRow, QueueItem, menu item vertical padding.

tokens.name: inset-card
tokens.usage: MEDIUM — card metadata padding.

tokens.name: inset-panel
tokens.usage: Popover, modal, drawer padding.

tokens.name: inset-hero
tokens.usage: SPACIOUS — hero and featured banner padding.

tokens.name: gap-grid
tokens.usage: Card grid gap (desktop).

tokens.name: gap-section
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between page sections.

radius.note: Six steps. Nesting rule: outer = inner + padding (card 14 = md 10 + space-1 4).

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkbox, badges, tags, cover thumbs in rows.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, chips-in-inputs, tooltips, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, menus, card artwork inside a frame.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: All media cards and the collectible frame.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, drawers, hero panels.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, switches, avatars, the Play button, search input.

shadow.note: Depth comes first from tone and borders; shadows are cool, low and short.

tokens.name: shadow-flat
tokens.usage: Default — rows, inline cards.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered cards, active sidebar item, selected segment.

tokens.name: shadow-floating
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, toasts, player bar.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals and drawers.

tokens.name: shadow-collectible
tokens.usage: FeaturedCard only — a cool lift under the foil frame.

borderWidth.note: Borders carry ICYRE's structure. Hairline for containers, strong for selection, frame for collectibles.

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Subtle, default, strong and interactive borders.

tokens.name: border-thick
tokens.usage: Selected and iridescent borders.

tokens.name: focus-ring-width
tokens.usage: Focus outline width.

tokens.name: focus-ring-offset
tokens.usage: Focus outline offset — clears the element's own border.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled cards and unavailable rows' artwork.

tokens.name: opacity-muted
tokens.usage: Played QueueItems.

tokens.name: opacity-holo
tokens.usage: Foil glint overlay strength.

duration.note: Motion tokens. Holo motion is the slowest and rarest; all motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover fills, icon swaps, press.

tokens.name: duration-normal
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, tooltips, card lift, player state.

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: Drawer, modal, toast enter.

tokens.name: duration-holo
tokens.usage: Foil glint sweep on FeaturedCard hover. Once per hover, never looped.

tokens.name: easing-standard
tokens.usage: Hover, menus, card interaction.

tokens.name: easing-emphasized
tokens.usage: Drawer, modal, play/pause morph.

tokens.name: easing-exit
tokens.usage: Anything leaving the screen.

layout.note: One system, three widths. Mobile < 768 ≤ Tablet < 1200 ≤ Desktop.

tokens.name: bp-tablet

tokens.name: bp-desktop

tokens.name: container-max

tokens.name: gutter-desktop

tokens.name: gutter-tablet

tokens.name: gutter-mobile

tokens.name: grid-columns-desktop

tokens.name: grid-columns-mobile

tokens.name: sidebar-width
